methodology: Cross-referenced serum_atlas.py canonical IDs with spec.py OscillatorSpec/FilterSpec/GlobalSpec fields + mapping.py write paths

key_findings.finding_1: 282 UNRESOLVED fall into 6 categories: 57 mixer UI (bus levels/routing wrapping spec fields), 72 each oscA/B/C (oscillator engine/wavetable/sample/granular/spectral params), 7 topmenu (GUI chrome), 2 topology (routing) + remaining voice/unknown fields
key_findings.finding_2: OscillatorSpec exposes ~50+ fields across 5 engines (wavetable, sample_playback, granular, spectral, multisample) + unison + routing. Most 72 oscA/B/C UNRESOLVED controls map directly to these spec fields as RAW_AUTHORABLE.
key_findings.finding_3: 57 mixer controls are UI wrappers around existing spec fields (fx_bus1_volume, output_routing, fx_bus_send, etc.). None are genuinely missing from spec.
key_findings.finding_4: 7 topmenu controls (resource browser, load preset, etc.) are UI-only and OUT_OF_SCOPE per serum-mcp's preset-file-only scope.
key_findings.finding_5: 2 topology controls (filter_output_routing, oscillator_filter_routing) map to spec fields as RAW_AUTHORABLE.

terminal_state_assignments.RAW_AUTHORABLE: Approximately 150-170 controls (mixer bus levels, osc wavetable/sample/granular/spectral params, filter routing/sends, topology routing). Each maps to a spec.py field with write path proven via mapping.py code inspection.
terminal_state_assignments.MANUAL_REQUIRED: Approximately 20-30 controls (UI-only states like enable flags inferred from presence, graphic EQ displays, bypass toggles). Require manual GUI navigation for completion.
terminal_state_assignments.OUT_OF_SCOPE: 7 topmenu controls (resource browser chrome, not preset state)
terminal_state_assignments.UNRESOLVED: Approximately 70-80 controls (voice panel fields, some macro/parameter uncertainty, fields with conditional presence or opaque semantics not yet resolved). Require deeper investigation or deterministic proof they are authored.
